articles.author: Doree Lewak
articles.title: Israeli mom whose son was murdered on Oct. 7 nearly lost daughter in hijacked flydubai terrorist attack
articles.description: An Israeli mom who lost her son in the Oct. 7 Hamas massacre nearly buried another child when her daughter survived an attempted hijacking aboard a flydubai flight Sept. 30 -- just days before the third anniversary of the attack.
articles.content:
An Israeli mom whose son was murdered in the Oct. 7 Hamas massacre cheated a second devastating tragedy when her daughter survived the attempted hijacking aboard a flydubai flight last week.
